name: Dizzying Bullet
body:
Source Ranged Tactics Toolbox pg. 24
Aura faint evocation CL 5th
Slot none; Price 496 gp ; Weight 1/2 lb.
Description
This +1 sling bullet makes a faint rattling noise when shaken. When it strikes a creature, the creature must succeed at a DC 13 Fortitude save or become stunned for 1 round.
Construction
Requirements Craft Magic Arms and Armor, sound burst; Price 251 gp
